definitions.explanation: Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment. Often used when something good happens to you.

examples.japanese: プレゼントをもらって{嬉|うれ}しいです。
examples.english: I'm happy to receive a present.

examples.japanese: {合格|ごうかく}して{嬉|うれ}しいです。
{手紙|てがみ}をもらって、とても{嬉|うれ}しかったです。
examples.english: I was very happy to receive the letter.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}が{元気|げんき}で{嬉|うれ}しいです。{毎日|まいにち}{一緒|いっしょ}にごはんを{食|た}べています。
examples.english: I'm happy that my family is well. We eat meals together every day.

notes:
{嬉|うれ}しい is an i-adjective meaning happy or glad - specifically the feeling when something good happens to you.

FORMS:
- Negative: {嬉|うれ}しくない
- Past: {嬉|うれ}しかった
- Adverb: {嬉|うれ}しく

CONTRAST WITH {楽|たの}しい:
- {嬉|うれ}しい: happy because something happened TO you
- {楽|たの}しい: enjoying an activity you're doing

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {会|あ}えて{嬉|うれ}しい: glad to meet you
- {嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き: tears of joy
- {嬉|うれ}しいことに: happily, fortunately

USAGE NOTE:
うれしい！ is commonly used as a casual exclamation of joy.
